# v0.3.4

## Compare Range
- v0.3.3..v0.3.4

## Highlights
- Fixed onboarding/auth behavior so providers are enabled only after successful setup, preventing unintended sync attempts for unconfigured providers.
- Added regression coverage to ensure failed auth flows do not force-enable providers in config.
- Improved auth UX by defaulting OAuth to browser callback capture and moving manual callback paste to explicit `--local` mode.
